```{r}
library("ape")
library("phangorn")
```


# Benchmark

Create the results matrix

```{r}
results = matrix(nrow = 100, 
                 ncol = 4, 
                 data = numeric(),
                 dimnames = list(
  paste("Tree_", 0:99),
  c("NJ", "UNJ", "MP", "ML")
))
```

And now iterate and score:

```{r}
for(i in 0:99){
  attempt <- tryCatch({
    # Load data and gt tree
    ## load, clean, write, read each nexus file
    raw <- readLines(paste("simulations_data/simulated_traditions_22_07/sequences_", i, ".nex", sep = ""))
    clean_raw <- gsub("ms\\_|[|]\\S*", "", raw)
    tmp <- tempfile(fileext = ".nex")
    writeLines(clean_raw, tmp)
    data <- ape::read.nexus.data(tmp)
    unlink(tmp)
    data = phyDat(data, type = "USER", levels = 0:10, ambiguity=NA)
    gt = ape::read.tree(file = paste("simulations_data/simulated_traditions_22_07/tree_", i, ".newick", sep = ""))
  }, error = function(e) {
    # Print a warning showing which file failed
    message(sprintf("Skipping iteration %d due to error: %s", i, e$message))
    return(NULL)
  })
  
  # --- 2. Skip to next iteration if loading failed ---
  if (is.null(attempt)) {
    next
  }
  # Perform analyses
  dm <- dist.ml(data)
  treeNJ <- NJ(dm)
  treeUNJ <- UNJ(dm)
  mm_start <- random.addition(data)
# Applying the pratchet method for maximum parsimony
# Default, fitch + SPR
  mm_tree <- pratchet(data, start = mm_start, minit = 10, maxit = 10000, all = TRUE, trace = 0, method = "fitch", rearrangements = "SPR", perturbation = "ratchet") # "The "fitch" algorithm only works correct for binary trees"
  #mm_tree <- acctran(mm_tree, data)
# Eliminating too short branches, to integrate polytomies/multifurcations
# we prune away internal edges of length tol (default = 1e-08), so our trees may contain multifurcations.
  #mm_tree  <- di2multi(mm_tree)
  
  results[i+1, "NJ"] <- Quartet::QuartetDivergence(Quartet::QuartetStatus(gt, treeNJ, nTip = TRUE), similarity = TRUE)
  results[i+1, "UNJ"] <- Quartet::QuartetDivergence(Quartet::QuartetStatus(gt, treeUNJ, nTip = TRUE), similarity = TRUE)
  results[i+1, "MP"] <- mean(Quartet::QuartetDivergence(Quartet::QuartetStatus(mm_tree, cf=gt, nTip = TRUE), similarity = TRUE))# taking the mean. Other option: take a consensus tree

}
```


Now plot:

```{r}
res = as.data.frame(results)
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(data = res) +
geom_boxplot(aes(x = "NJ", y = NJ)) +
geom_boxplot(aes(x = "UNJ", y = UNJ)) +
geom_boxplot(aes(x = "MP", y = MP)) +
xlab("Method") +
ylab("Quartet similarity") +
ggtitle("Unrooted trees similarity to GT")
```

```{r}
results
```
